column5: Description
ESP32 DevKit + accelerometer on the sock. Firmware: SockPod/SockPod.ino (esp32:esp32 3.0.7).
GATT service a8f5c3e0-6d2b-4f1a-9c7e-3b5d8e2f1a00 with Live, Session and Control characteristics. See README.
Thresholds set from two guided on-the-spot motion tests on 2026-10-19 (motion_test.py, motion_logs/).
frontend/: plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript using Web Bluetooth. No build step.
https://vaibhavraj-0906.github.io/sockpod/ from https://github.com/vaibhavraj-0906/sockpod
Test cases and results. Bluetooth: ble_test.py. Serial: serial_tool.py. Web app: hosted copy in demo mode.
Planned for a future update.
Open issues found during testing and review.

column4: Install the CP210x USB driver and the ESP32 Arduino core 3.0.7
column5: Driver installed 2026-10-16 (board on COM7). Core installed 2026-10-19 with resumable downloads, because GitHub release downloads fail on the hostel Wi-Fi.

column4: Read the accelerometer at 100 Hz with gravity calibration
column5: Raw-register reads at 100 Hz over I2C at 100 kHz. Whenever the pod is still for a second, its reading is taken as 1 g (this clone reads about 1.15-1.19 g at rest).
A foot strike is a spike above STEP_G (1.8 g). The pod sees one foot, so steps = 2 x strikes.

column4: Detect jumps and jump height from airtime
column5: Airtime from below AIR_G (0.6 g) to a landing above LAND_G (1.5 g). Height = g x t^2 / 8.
At least 180 steps/min at vigorous intensity for 3 s or more.

column4: Track intensity and active / rest time
column5: ENMO each second. Rest below 0.07 g with no foot strike; moderate from 0.15 g; vigorous from 0.60 g.

column4: Start/stop sessions and keep the last one in flash
column5: BOOT button, serial 's' or the app. The finished session's summary survives a reboot. LED: blip every 2 s idle, 1 Hz blink recording.
s = start/stop, l = live JSON, p = Serial Plotter mode, r = last session. 115200 baud.
It fell off the I2C bus after the motion tests. Elevation is now reported as off (baro = 0).

column4: Advertise as SockPod with Live, Session and Control characteristics
column5: Live: read + notify. Session: read. Control: write 'start' or 'stop'. All values UTF-8 JSON.

column4: Send live stats once a second in one notification
column5: MTU 247 so the live JSON (up to about 150 bytes) fits one notification.

column4: Start and stop sessions from the app
column5: Control characteristic accepts 'start' and 'stop'; other values are ignored.
Prompts through standing, walking, jogging, jumping, sprinting and seated tapping; saves a labelled 50 Hz trace.

column4: Tune thresholds from two motion tests
column5: Second test: 61 s rest vs 63 s active, 0 false strikes from seated tapping, 4 of 5 jumps (9-33 cm), 1 sprint.

column4: Connect over Web Bluetooth and show live stats
column5: Timer, active/rest, steps, cadence, intensity, jumps, sprints, elevation (Off on the real pod).

column4: Start and stop a session from the app
column5: Same as the pod's BOOT button.
Each finished session is read from the pod and saved in localStorage. Details view, Export as JSON, Clear.
A simulated pod running a scripted one-minute workout.
Retries for about 20 s after a dropout. Explains when Web Bluetooth is unavailable and offers the demo.
Public repo vaibhavraj-0906/sockpod. secrets.h and the vendor driver are git-ignored.
